Topics · Who was Muhammad?

Where did the Quran's prophet stories come from?

After its great stories the Quran says how they reached its Prophet. These lines, and what they claim.

Part 1 of 3

﴿تِلْكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهَآ إِلَيْكَ ۖ مَا كُنتَ تَعْلَمُهَآ أَنتَ وَلَا قَوْمُكَ مِن قَبْلِ هَـٰذَا ۖ فَٱصْبِرْ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلْعَـٰقِبَةَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal to you, [O Muḥammad]. You knew it not, neither you nor your people, before this. So be patient; indeed, the [best] outcome is for the righteous.

Quran · Hud 11:49

﴿ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ أَجْمَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَمْكُرُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal, [O Muḥammad], to you. And you were not with them when they put together their plan while they conspired.

Quran · Yusuf 12:102

﴿ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ ۚ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يُلْقُونَ أَقْلَـٰمَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ يَكْفُلُ مَرْيَمَ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal to you, [O Muḥammad]. And you were not with them when they cast their pens[124] as to which of them should be responsible for Mary. Nor were you with them when they disputed.

Translator's notes

[124] i.e., threw lots.

Quran · Aal Imran 3:44

Read three stories: Noah, Joseph and Mary. Each stops to say how it reached the Prophet: this is news of the unseen, revealed to you. After Noah's account it adds: neither you nor your people knew it before. After the other two: you were not with them. A storyteller usually hopes no one asks about his sources. This book raises the question itself, right beside the story. You may or may not accept its answer. You cannot say the question was avoided.

A question for you

What does it tell you that the book keeps raising the question of its own source?

If you sayIt has nothing to hide.
ThenThat fits the surface of the text. The next part shows how far the book takes it.
If you sayIt is answering critics.
ThenVery likely, since the Quran records its critics. Yet an answer given in public, before critics, stays a claim they could test.
If you sayIt is only a literary device.
ThenIt could be. Then ask what the device puts at risk: whoever says 'neither you nor your people' can be contradicted by those in the room.

Part 2 of 3

﴿وَمَا كُنتَ بِجَانِبِ ٱلْغَرْبِىِّ إِذْ قَضَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَى ٱلْأَمْرَ وَمَا كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ٤٤ وَلَـٰكِنَّآ أَنشَأْنَا قُرُونًا فَتَطَاوَلَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْعُمُرُ ۚ وَمَا كُنتَ ثَاوِيًا فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ تَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا وَلَـٰكِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ٤٥ وَمَا كُنتَ بِجَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ إِذْ نَادَيْنَا وَلَـٰكِن رَّحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّآ أَتَىٰهُم مِّن نَّذِيرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ٤٦﴾

Translation of the meaning

And you, [O Muḥammad], were not on the western side [of the mount] when We revealed to Moses the command, and you were not among the witnesses [to that]. But We produced [many] generations [after Moses], and prolonged was their duration.[1107] And you were not a resident among the people of Madyan, reciting to them Our verses, but We were senders [of this message].[1108] And you were not at the side of the mount when We called [Moses] but [were sent] as a mercy from your Lord to warn a people to whom no warner had come before you that they might be reminded.

Translator's notes

[1107] So they forgot and neglected the ordinances of Allāh. [1108] The Prophet (ﷺ) had no way of obtaining this information except through Allāh's revelation.

Quran · Al-Qasas 28:44-46

The Quran does the same with Moses, in greater detail. You were not on the western side when the command was decreed. You were not living among the people of Midian. You were not beside the mountain when the call came. Three places, each named, each denied. Then the reason: long generations had passed, and what came, came as mercy from your Lord. The passage names no other way he learned of these places. It says the knowledge came from his Lord.

A question for you

What would you want to check first?

If you sayWhether the story matches the Torah.
ThenThe agreement can be seen. The next part sets it before you with Joseph.
If you sayWhether he could have heard it from others.
ThenA serious question, and it has a Step that gives his opponents' words exactly.
If you sayWhether his people already knew it.
ThenThat is what 11:49 speaks to, and it can be weighed in its own Step.

Part 3 of 3

﴿لَقَدْ كَانَ فِى قَصَصِهِمْ عِبْرَةٌ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ ۗ مَا كَانَ حَدِيثًا يُفْتَرَىٰ وَلَـٰكِن تَصْدِيقَ ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَتَفْصِيلَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding. Never was it [i.e., the Qur’ān] a narration invented, but a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of all things and guidance and mercy for a people who believe.

Quran · Yusuf 12:111

﴿نَحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْقَصَصِ بِمَآ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ وَإِن كُنتَ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ لَمِنَ ٱلْغَـٰفِلِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

We relate to you, [O Muḥammad], the best of stories in what We have revealed to you of this Qur’ān although you were, before it, among the unaware.

Quran · Yusuf 12:3

Now compare the result. The story of Joseph stands in Genesis and in the Quran: a beloved son, jealous brothers, a well, a sale, Egypt, dreams, and a family reunited at last. The agreement is plain. The Quran says why: this was no invented account, but a confirmation of what came before. So you hold two facts. The story is very old and kept by others. And the one reciting it is said to have been unaware of it before. What joins those two facts?

A question for you

What best explains one story kept in two such books?

If you sayOne copied from the other.
ThenThen the route of copying is the thing to examine, and that has its own Step.
If you sayThey have one source.
ThenThen the question is what kind of source that could be, and that has its own Step.
If you sayBoth draw on an old shared tradition.
ThenMany historians would say so. It leaves open where the tradition began and how it reached him.

Your reflection

Which story of the prophets do you know best, and who first told it to you?
